explanation: The value is 0 at GO and D2 and almost always 0 at D1; it jumps to about 10 only at D1, late in the episode (around trial 80 or later), when the agent has been steadily choosing a2 and the previous trial was a rare a2-to-S1 transition that paid a reward (about 0 before trial 80 or if the agent switches to a1 on that trial). If that late rare a2-to-S1 trial paid nothing, the next D1 is weaker, about 2 to 5, and every other step, including all trials earlier in the episode, is 0.
